name: Jezero Crater, Mars
description: Perseverance's field site: delta, crater floor and western rim. HiRISE 1 m DTMs over the rover traverse, CTX 20 m DEM over the whole crater.

projection.name: Jezero_Crater_Projection
projection.note: JPL Mars 2020 science projection; equirectangular, standard parallel 18.4663 deg, Mars 2000 sphere

clock.name: M2020
clock.note: Mars 2020 mission sols (sol 0 = landing day) at the landing longitude

quality_note: USGS metadata: the crater-rim (CR) pairs have uncompensated y-parallax outside the landing ellipse; their bedform evidence is down-weighted.

targets.name: Habitat (Octavia E. Butler Landing)
targets.why: Perseverance's certified-safe landing point; first rover localisation, sol 13 [NASA feed].

targets.name: Rochette (first rock cores)
targets.why: First cored samples Montdenier / Montagnac (~sol 190-196); igneous crater floor (Maaz formation).
targets.source: M20 waypoints feed, sol 180; NASA sample reports

targets.name: Delta top (sol 1000 position)
targets.why: Upper fan / delta-top deposits reached as the mission passed 1,000 sols.

targets.name: Cheyava Falls (Sapphire Canyon core)
targets.why: Rock with 'leopard spot' features NASA called a potential biosignature; cored 21 Jul 2024 = sol 1215.
targets.source: M20 waypoints feed, end-of-drive sol 1210 (rover parked there until sol 1219)

targets.name: Crater rim crest (reached 12 Dec 2024)
targets.why: Highest point of the rim ascent (-3,468 m on the feed's radius datum); ancient crust and megabreccia.
targets.source: M20 waypoints feed, sol 1354 (rim top reached sol 1356)

targets.name: Perseverance (latest position, sol 1980)
targets.why: Active robotic asset beyond the crater rim; approach no closer than 50 m.

keepouts.name: Three Forks Sample Depot (10 cached tubes)
keepouts.why: Tubes dropped sols 653-690 (21 Dec 2022 - 28 Jan 2023) at these rover end-of-drive positions; 60 m buffer.
keepouts.source: M20 waypoints feed sols 652-686; NASA depot announcements

keepouts.name: Perseverance rover (active asset)
keepouts.why: Do not approach an active rover closer than 50 m [ASSUME].
